doc_title_en: Notice of Earnings Forecast Revision (Upward Revision) and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 業績予想の修正（上方修正）及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績予想の上方修正を踏まえて、配当性向30%を目安とした安定的な配当方針により増配

summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥51.00/share from ¥46.00/share (¥5.00 increase, 10.9% hike) for FY10/26, on upward earnings revision. Comprises ¥45.00 ordinary dividend and ¥6.00 commemorative dividend. Target payout ratio approximately 30%.
summary_jp: FY10/26年間配当を46円00銭から51円00銭に引き上げ（5円00銭増、10.9%）。業績上方修正に基づき。内訳：普通配当45円00銭、記念配当6円00銭。配当性向30%が基本方針。
tag_en: Dividend hike – FY10/26 – ¥51.00/share (¥5.00 increase) – payout ratio ~30%
